title: Improve Dana-i driver handling of Timezone Changes and Daylight Saving Time (auto-sync pump time with phone time)
symptom: For the Dana-i insulin pump, timezone changes and Daylight Saving Time (DST) transitions can cause issues in AAPS because the pump stores timestamps in local time without timezone information. This may lead to duplicated treatments after timezone changes, incorrect interpretation of pump history, temporary inaccuracies in IOB/COB, and the need for manual workarounds such as profile time shift or history reset.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It discusses that Dana pumps store history in local time without timezone info, which can cause ambiguous timestamps after timezone changes, but this is not confirmed as the cause by the maintainer.
fix: The thread does not state a resolution. The maintainer comments that Dana-i is the only pump surviving timezone travelling and DST changes internally, but no specific fix or workaround is provided.
evidence_quote: Dana-i is the only pump surviving timezone travelling and DST changes internaly
